statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
There is concern for supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
The service is to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate them with symptomatic complaints of giddiness
The denial reason is CO-197, indicating that required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered
